verdict.rationale: Rainforest offers both API and UI surfaces (Platform Portal, Component Studio) and docs show overlapping capabilities—e.g., merchant onboarding can be done via API, Portal, or embeddable Component (rainforest-docs-21, rainforest-docs-31, rainforest-docs-35)—plus a full OpenAPI spec (rainforest-docs-26). However there is no explicit documentation asserting full feature parity between UI and API for all functions (e.g., billing profile management, Tap to Phone SDK, dispute/reporting flows are not clearly shown as API-accessible). Missing for 10: explicit parity statement, evidence every Portal-only action (e.g., billing profile configuration) has an API equivalent, and independent/hands-on confirmation.
